name: list_devices
description: List all smart-home devices known to HOMEd. Each entry has the device `name`, an optional user `note` (free-text annotation set in homed-web UI — often hints at location, purpose or other context; omitted when empty) and a `properties` map keyed by endpoint ("common" or a numeric id). Individual sub-properties may carry a `display_name` — user-defined human-readable name set in homed-web UI; for multi-channel devices the device `name` is often generic (e.g. "Реле освещения") and the channel name (e.g. "Мастерская") lives inside the relevant sub-property's `display_name`. To find a device by a human phrase, call this with no filters and scan the device `name`, its `note` and the `display_name`s of its sub-properties — the full list is small enough.

service.description: Optional filter by HOMEd service topic (e.g. 'zigbee').

name: get_device
description: Return full information about a single device: its `name`, optional user `note` (free-text annotation, omitted when empty) and writable/readable properties with their current values and schema. Pass either the canonical key ("<type>/<id>") or the device name.

name: set_properties
description:
Publish property updates to HOMEd devices in a single batch call. Always prefer one call with many operations to many sequential calls.

One operation targets ONE (device, endpoint) pair. To know what you can write, call get_device (or list_devices) and inspect `properties.<endpoint>`: every entry with `writable: true` may be set, the key is the exact sub-key you put under `properties`, and `enum`/`min`/`max`/`unit`/`note` describe the accepted value. `endpoint` is the numeric key — omit it for `properties.common` (also when sub-keys carry a `_N` suffix). Group several sub-keys of the same (device, endpoint) into one operation.

Operations are processed independently — failure on one does not abort the others.

operations.description: Array of independent updates. Each item targets ONE (device, endpoint) pair and may carry multiple sub-keys.

endpoint.description: Numeric endpoint id. Set when the sub-keys live under properties["<N>"]. Do NOT set when they live in properties.common.

properties.description: Map of sub-key → target value, all written to the same td/ topic in ONE message. Keys are bare (e.g. "status", "level") when `endpoint` is set OR the device is single-endpoint; they carry a _N suffix (e.g. "status_5") only when the matching item is in common with a _N suffix and `endpoint` is NOT set. Values: boolean for toggle/button, string for status/select/systemMode/etc., number for level/position/targetTemperature, array [r,g,b] for color.

name: query_history
description: Query recorded values for a (device, endpoint, property) triple from homed-recorder. Returns timestamps and values (or hourly aggregates for long ranges). Only properties that carry `history: true` in get_device/list_devices are recorded — querying any other property returns an error.

endpoint.description: Numeric endpoint id. Set when the property lives under properties["<N>"]. Do NOT set when it lives in properties.common.

property.description: Property sub-key, exactly as it appears under properties.<endpoint> in get_device (must have `history: true`).

start.description: Range start, Unix timestamp in milliseconds.

end.description: Range end, Unix timestamp in milliseconds.
